known_source_gaps.note: The source document's own numbering jumps from 500 straight to 551 ('SERİ 551-600' follows item 500 directly) - items 501-550 were never written in the source, not a parsing bug. Confirmed by direct inspection of the source text around that boundary. The document's closing line ('liste 1050 içerik başlığını geçti') describes the highest NUMBER used, not the true item count (1000, not 1050).
